detail.longDescription: I finally got around to announcing my 3D rock-paper-scissors # fractal landscape mod on the # Luanti forums: https:// forum.luanti.org/viewtopic.php ?t=32783 This post contains some new screenshots and some description of my development process and challenges I haven't posted elsewhere yet. I still plan on making a video, since it's hard to really convey how weird these worlds are with static images. Check out the paper if you're curious about the # math involved: https:// aten.cool/documents/papers/A%2 0rock-paper-scissors%20Mandelbrot%20set%20%5B2026%5D.pdf # mathematics # fractals # Mandelbrot # MandelbrotSet # Lua # LuaLang # RockPaperScissors # research
